text.body: <1> prathamo'dhyāyaḥ praṇamya śirasā viṣṇuṃ trailokyādhipatiṃ prabhum | nānāśāstrodadhṛtaṃ vajñye rājanītisamuccayam ||1|| adhītdaṃye yathāśāstraṃ naro jānāti sattamaḥ | dharmopadeśaṃ vikhyātaṃ kāryā'kārya śubhā'śubham ||2|| tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā | yena vijñānāmātreṇa sarvajñatvaṃ prapadyate ||3|| mūrkhaśiṣyopadeśena duṣṭāstrībharaṇena ca | duḥkhitai samprayogeṇa paṇiḍto'pyavasīdati ||4|| duṣṭābhāryā śaṭhaṃ mitraṃ bhṛtyaścottaradāyakaḥ | sasarpe ca gṛhe vāso mṛtyureva naḥ saṃśayaḥ ||5|| āpadarthe dhanaṃ rakṣeddārān rakṣedhdanairapi | ātmānaṃ satataṃ rakṣeddārairapi dhanairapi ||6|| āpadārthe dhanaṃ rakṣecchrīmataśca kimāpadaḥ | kadāciccaletā lakṣmīḥsaṃcito'pivinaśyati ||7|| yasmin deśe na sammāno na vṛttirna ca bāndhavaḥ | na ca vidyāgama'pyasti vāsastatra na kārayet ||8|| dhanikaḥ śrotriyo rājā nadī vaidyastu pañcamaḥ | pañca yatra na vidyante na tatra divasaṃ vaseta ||9|| lokayātrā bhayaṃ lajjā dākṣiṇāyaṃ tyāgaśīlatā | pañca yatra na vidyante na kuryyāttatra saḍgatim ||10|| jānīyāt preṣaṇe bhṛtyān bāndhavān vyasanāgame | mitraṃ cāpattikāle tu bhāryāṃ ca vibhavakṣaye ||11|| āture vyasane prāpte durbhikṣe śatrusaṃkaṭe | rājadvāre śmaśāne ca yastiṣṭhati sa bāndhavaḥ ||12|| yo dhruvāṇi parityajya adhruvaṃ pariṣevate | dhruvāṇi tasya naśyanti adhruvaṃ naṣṭameva hi ||13|| varayetkulajāṃ prājño virūpāmapi kanyakām | rūpaśīlāṃ na nīcasya vivāhaḥ sadrṝśe kule ||14|| nadīnāṃ śasrapāṇīnāṃ nakhīnāṃ śrṛḍgiṇāṃ tathā | viśvāso naiva kartavyaḥ strīṣurājakuleṣu ca ||15|| viṣādapyamṛtaṃ grāhyamamedhyādapi kāñcanam | nīcādapyuttamāṃ vidyāṃstrīratnaṃ duṣkulādapi ||16|| strīṇāṃ dviguṇa āhāro lajjā cāpi caturgaṇā | sāhasaṃ ṣaḍrguṇaṃ caiva kāmaścāṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛta ||17|| <2> dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ anṛtaṃ sāhasaṃ māyā mūrkhatvamātilobhitā | aśaucatvaṃ nirdayatvaṃ strīṇāṃdoṣāḥsvabhāvajāḥ ||1|| bhojyaṃ bhojanaśaktiśca ratiśaktirvarāḍganā | vibhavo dānaśaktiśca nā'lpasya tapasaḥ phalam ||2|| yasya putro vaśībhūto bhāryā chandānugāminī | vibhave yaśca santuṣṭastasya svarga ihaiva hi ||3|| te putrā ye piturbhaktāḥ sa pitā yastu poṣakaḥ | tanmitraṃyatraviśvāsaḥsā bhāryā yatra nivṛtiḥ ||4|| parokṣe kāryyahantāraṃ pratyakṣe priyavādinam|| varjjayettādṛśaṃ mitraṃ viṣakumbhampayomukham ||5|| na viśvasetkumitre ca mitre cāpi na viśvaset | kadācitkupitaṃ mitraṃ sarvaguhyaṃ prakāśayet ||6|| manasā cintitaṃ kāryaṃ vacasā na prakāśayet | maṃtreṇa rakṣayed gūḍhaṃ kāryya cāpi niyojayet ||7|| kaṣṭañca khalu mūrkhatvaṃ kaṣṭaṃ ca khalu yauvanam | kaṣṭāt kaṣṭataraṃ caiva paragehe nivāsanam ||8|| śaile śaile na māṇikyaṃ mauktikaṃ na gaje gaje | sādhavo nahi sarvatra candanaṃ na vane vane ||9|| putrāśca vividhaiḥ śīlairniyojyāḥ satataṃ budhaiḥ | nītijñāḥ śīlasampannā bhavanti kulapūjitāḥ ||10|| mātā śatruḥ pitā vairī yena bālo na pāṭhitaḥ | na śobhate sabhāmadhye haṃsamadhye vako yathā ||11|| lālanād bahavo doṣāstāḍanād bahavo guṇāḥ | tasmātputraṃ ca śiṣyaṃ ca tāḍayennatulālayet ||12|| ślokena vā tadardhdā'rdhdākṣareṇa vā | avanghyaṃ divasaṃ kuryāddānādhyayanakarmabhiḥ ||13|| kāntā viyogaḥ svajanāpamāni | raṇasya śeṣaḥ kunṛpasya sevā || daridrabhāvo viṣamā sabhā ca | vināgninā te pradahanti kāyam ||14|| nadītīre ca ye vṛkṣāḥ parageheṣu kāminī | maṃtrihīnāśca rājānaḥ śīghraṃ naśyantyasaṃśayam ||15|| balaṃ vidyā ca viprāṇāṃ rājñāṃ sainyaṃ balaṃ tathā | balaṃvittañcavaiśyānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ paricaryikā ||16|| nirdhdanaṃ puruṣaṃ veśyā prajā bhagnaṃ nṛpa tyajet | khagā vītaphalaṃ vṛkṣaṃ bhuktvācābhyāgatogṛham ||17|| gṛhītvā dakṣiṇāṃ viprāstyajanti yajamānakam | prāptavidyāguruṃśiṣyodagdhāraṇyaṃmṛgāstathā ||18|| durācārī durādṛṣṭirdurāvāsī ca durjanaḥ | yanmaitrīkriyate pumbhirnaraḥśīghraṃ vinaśyati ||19|| samāne śobhate prītiḥ rājñi sevā ca śobhate | vāṇijyaṃvyavahāreṣu strī divyā śobhate gṛhe ||20|| <3> tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ kasya doṣaḥ kulenāsti vyādhinā ke na pīḍitaḥ | vyasanaṃ ke na saṃprāptaṃ kasya saukhyaṃ nirantaram ||1|| ācāraḥ kulamākhyāti deśamākhyāti bhāṣaṇam | sambhramaḥ snehamākhyātivapurākhyāti bhojanam ||2|| satkule yojayetkanyāṃ putraṃ vidyāsu yojatet | vyasane yojayecchatruṃ mitraṃ dharme niyojayet ||3|| durjanasya ca sarpasya varaṃ sarpo na durjanaḥ | sarpo daṃśati kāle tu durjanastu pade pade ||4|| edatarthaṃ kulonānāṃ nṛpāḥ kurvanti saṃgraham | ādimadhyāvasāneṣu na syajanti ca te nṛpam ||5|| pralaye bhinnamaryādā bhavanti kila sāgarāḥ | sāgarā bhedamicchānti pralaye'pi na sādhavaḥ ||6|| mūrkhastu pariharttavyaḥ pratyakṣo dvipadaḥ paśuḥ | bhidyate vākyaśūlena adṛśyaṃ kaṇṭakaṃ yathā ||7|| rūpayauvanasampannā viśālakulasambhavāḥ | vidyāhīnā na śobhante nirgandhā ivakiśukāḥ ||8|| kokilānāṃ svaro rūpaṃ nārīrūpaṃ pativratam | vidyārūpaṃ kurūpāṇāṃkṣamā rūpaṃ rapasvinām ||9|| tyajedekaṃ kulasyārthe grāmasyārthe kulaṃ tyajet | grāmaṃ janapadasyārthe ātmārthe pṛthivīṃ tyajet ||10|| udyoge nāsti dāridrya japato nāsti pātakam | maunenakalahonāsti nāsti jāgarito bhayam ||11|| atirūpeṇa vai sītā atigarveṇaḥ rāvaṇaḥ | atidānābdalirbadhdo hyati sarvatra varjayet ||12|| ko'tibhāraḥ samarthānāṃ kiṃ dūraṃ vyavasāyinām| ko videśaḥ suvidyānāṃ kaḥ paraḥ priyavādinām ||13|| ekenāpi suvṛkṣeṇa dahyamānena gandhinā | vāsitaṃ tadvanaṃ sarvaṃ kuputreṇa kulaṃ yathā ||14|| ekena śuṣkavṛkṣeṇa dahyamānena vanhinā | dahyate tadvanaṃ sarva kuputreṇa kulaṃ yathā ||15|| ekenāpi suputreṇa vidyāyuktena sādhunā | ālhāditaṃ kulaṃ sarvaṃ yathā candreṇa śarvarī ||16|| kiṃ jārtaibahubhiḥ putraiḥ śokasantāpakārakaiḥ | varamekaḥ kulālambī yatra viśrāmyate kulam ||17|| lālayetpañcavarṣāṇi daśa varṣāṇi tāḍayeta | prāpte tu ṣoḍaśe varṣe putraṃ mitravadācaret ||18|| upasarge'nyacakre ca durbhikṣe ca bhayāvahe | asādhujanasamparke yaḥ palāyati jīvati ||19|| dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu yasyaiko'pi na vidyate | janmjanmani martyeṣa maraṇaṃ tasya kevalam ||20|| mūrkhā yatra na pujyante dhānyaṃ yatra susañcitam | dāmpatye kalaho nāsti tatra śrīḥ svayamāgatā ||21|| <4> caturtho'dhyāyaḥ āyuḥ karma ca vittañca vidyā nidhanameva ca | pañcaitāni hi sṛjyante garbhasthasyaiva dehinaḥ ||1|| sādhubhyaste nivartante putrāmitrāṇi bāndhavāḥ | ye ca taiḥ saha gantārastadhdarmātsukṛtaṃ kulam ||2|| darśanādhyānasaṃsparśairmatsī kūrmī ca pakṣiṇī | śiśupālayate nityaṃ tathā sajjanasaḍgatiḥ ||3|| yāvatsvastho hyayaṃ deho yāvanmṛtyuśca dūrataḥ | tāvadātmahitaṃ kuryāt prāṇānte kiṃ kariṣyati||4|| kāmadhenuguṇa vidyā hyakāle phaladāyinī | pravāse mātṛsadṛśī vidyā guptaṃ dhanaṃ smṛtam ||5|| eko'pi guṇavān putro nirguṇaiśca śatairvaraḥ | ekaścandrastamo hanti na ca tārāḥ sahastraśaḥ ||6|| mūrkhaścirāyurjāto'pi tasmājjātamṛto varaḥ | mṛtaḥ sa cā'lpaduḥkhāya yāvajjīvaṃ jaḍodahet ||7|| kugrāmavāsaḥ kulahīnasevā | kubhojanaṃ krodhamukhī ca bhāryā || putraśca mūrkho vidhavā ca kanyā | vināgnimete pradahanti kāyam ||8|| kiṃ tayā kriyate dhenvā yā na dogdhrī na garbhiṇī | ko'rthaḥ putreṇa jātena yo na vidvānna bhaktimān ||9|| saṃsāratāpadagdhānāṃ trayo viśrāntehetavaḥ | apatyaṃ ca kalatraṃ ca satāṃ saḍgatireva ca ||10|| sakṛjjalpanti rājānaḥ sakṛjjalpanti paṇḍitāḥ | sakṛtkanyāḥ pradīyante trīṇyetāni sakṛtsakṛt ||11|| ekākinā tapo dvābhyāṃ paṭhanaṃ gāyanaṃ tribhiḥ | caturbhirgamanaṃ kṣetraṃ paṃcabhirbahubhī raṇam ||12|| sā bhāryā yā śucirdakṣā sā bhāryā yā pativratā | sā bhāryā yā patiprītā sābhāryā satyavādino ||13|| aputrasya gṛhaṃ śūnyaṃ diśaḥ śunyāstvabāṃdhavāḥ | mūrkhasya hṛdayaṃ śūnyaṃ sarvaśūnyā daridratā ||14|| anabhyāse viṣaṃ śāstramajīrṇe bhojanaṃ viṣam | daridrasya viṣaṃ goṣṭhī vṛdhdasya taruṇī viṣam ||15|| tyajedhdarma dayāhīnaṃ vidyāhīnaṃ guruṃ tyajet | tyajetkrodhamukhīṃ bhāryānniḥ snehānabaṃdhavāṃstyajet ||16|| adhvā jarā manuṣyāṇāṃ vājināṃ baṃdhanaṃ jarā | amaithunaṃ jarā strīṇāṃ vastrāṇāmātapaṃ jarā ||17|| kaḥkālaḥ kāni mitrāṇi ko deśaḥ ko vyayāgamau | kasyāhaṃ kā ca meśaktiriti cintyaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||18|| agnirdevo dvijātīnāṃ munīnāṃ hṛdi daivatam | pratimā tvalpabudhdīnāṃ sarvatra samadarśinām ||19|| <5> pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ gururagnirdvi jātīnāṃ varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo guruḥ | patireva guruḥ strīṇāṃ sarvasyābhyāgato guruḥ ||1|| yathā caturbhiḥ kanakaṃ parākṣyate nigharṣaṇaṃ chedanatāpatāḍanaiḥ | tathā caturbhiḥ puruṣaḥ parīkṣyate tyāgena śīlena guṇena karmaṇā ||2|| tāvadbhayena bhetavyaṃ yāvad bhayamanāgatam | āgataṃ tu bhayaṃ vīkṣyaṃ prahartavyamaśaṃkayā ||3|| ekodarasamud bhūtā ekanakṣatrajātakāḥ | na bhavanti samāḥ śīlā yathā badarikaṇṭakāḥ ||4|| niḥspṛho nādhikārī syānnākāmo maṇḍanapriyaḥ | nā'vidagdhaḥ priyaṃbrūyāt spaṣṭavaktā na vañcakaḥ ||5|| mūrkhāṇāṃ paṇḍitā dveṣyā adhanānāṃ mahādhanāḥ | varāṃganā kulastrīṇāṃ subhagānāṃ ca durbhagā ||6|| ālasyopagatā vidyā parahastagataṃ dhanam | alpabījaṃ hataṃ kṣetraṃ hataṃ sainyamanāyakam ||7|| abhyāsādhdāryate vidyā kulaṃ śīlena dhāryate | guṇena jñāyate tvāryaḥ kopo netreṇa gamyate ||8|| vittena rakṣyate dharmo vidyā yogena rakṣyate | mṛdunā rakṣyate bhūpaḥ satstriyā rakṣyate gṛham ||9|| anyathā vedapāṇḍityaṃ śāstramācāramanyathā | anyathā vadatā śāṃtaṃlokāḥkliśyanti cā'nyathā ||10|| dāridryanāśanaṃ dāna śīlaṃ durgatināśanam | ajñānanāśinī prajñā bhāvanā bhayanāśinī ||11|| nāsti kāmasamo vyādhirnāsti mohasamo ripuḥ | nāsti kopasamo vahni rnāsti jñānātparaṃ sukham ||12|| janmamṛtyuṃ hi yātyeko bhunaktyekaṃ śubhāśubham | narakeṣu patatyeka eko yāti parāṃ gatim ||13|| tṛṇaṃ brahmavidaḥ svargastṛṇaṃ śūrasya jīvitam | jitākṣasya tṛṇaṃ nārī niḥspṛhasya tṛṇaṃ jagat ||14|| vidyā mitraṃ pravāseṣu bhāryā mitraṃ gṛheṣu ca | vyadhitasyauṣadhaṃ mitraṃ dharmo mitraṃ mṛtasya ca ||15|| vṛthā vṛṣṭissamudreṣu vṛthā tṛpteṣu bhojanam | vṛthā dānaṃ dhanāḍhyeṣu vṛthā dīpo'dīvā'pi ca ||16|| nāsti meghasamaṃ toyaṃ nāsti cātmasamaṃ balam | nāsticakṣuḥ samaṃ tejo nāsti dhānyasamaṃ priyam ||17|| adhanā dhanamicchanti vācaṃ caiva catuṣpadaḥ | mānavāḥ svargamicchanti mokṣamicchantidevatāḥ ||18|| styena dhāryate pṛthvī styena tapate raviḥ | styena vāti vāyuśca sarvaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitam ||19|| calā lakṣmīścalāḥ prāṇaścale jīvitamandire | calā'cale ca saṃsāre dharma eko hi niścalaḥ ||20|| narāṇāṃ nāpito dhūrtaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ caiva vāyasaḥ | catuṣpadāṃ śrṛgālastu strīṇāṃ dhurtā ca mālinī ||21|| janitā copanetā ca yastu vidyāṃ prayacchati | annadātā bhayatrātā pañcaite pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ||22|| rājapatnī guroḥ patnī mitra patnī tathaiva ca | patnī mātā svamātā ca pañcaitā mātaraḥ smṛtā ||23|| <6> ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ śrutvā dharmaṃ vijānāti śrutvā tyajati durmatim | śrutvā jñānamavāpnoti śrutvā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||1|| pakṣiṇāṃ kākacāṇḍālaḥ paśūnāṃ caiva kukkuraḥ | munīnāṃ pāpī cāṇḍālaḥ sarvacāṇḍālanindakaḥ ||2|| bhasmanā śudhyate kāṃsyaṃ tāmramamlena śudhyati | rajasā śudhyate nāri nadī vegena śudhyati ||3|| bhramansaṃpūjyate rājā bhramansaṃpūjyate dvijaḥ | bhramansaṃpūjyate yogī strī bhramantī vinaśyati ||4|| yasyārthāstasya mitrāṇi yasyarthāstasya bāṃdhavāḥ | yasyāthāḥ sa pumāṃlloke yasyārthāḥ saca paṇḍitaḥ ||5|| tādṛśī jāyate budhdirvyavasāyo'pi tādṛśaḥ | sahāyāstādṛśā eva yādṛśī bhavitavyatā ||6|| kālaḥ pacati bhūtāni kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ | kālaḥ supteṣu jāgarti kālo hi duratikramaḥ ||7|| naiva paśyati janmādhaḥ kāmāndho naiva paśyati | madonmattā na paśyanti arthī doṣaṃ na paśyati ||8|| svayaṃ karma karotyatmā svayaṃ tatphalamaśnute | svayaṃ bhramati saṃsāre svayaṃ tasmādvimucyate ||9|| rājā rāṣṭrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ rājñaḥ pāpaṃ purohitaḥ | bhartā ca strīkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śiṣyapāpaṃ gurustathā ||10|| ṛṇakartā pitā śatrumātā ca vyabhicāriṇī | bhāryā rūpavatī śatruḥ putraḥ śatrurapaṇḍitaḥ ||11|| lubdhamarthena gṛhiṇīyāt stabdhamañjalikarmaṇā | mūrkhaṃ chandānuvṛtyā ca yathārthatvena paṇḍitam ||12|| varaṃ na rājyaṃ na kurājarājyaṃ varaṃ na mitraṃ na kumitramitram | varaṃ na śiṣyo na kuśiṣyaśiṣyo varaṃ na dārā na kudāradārāḥ ||13|| kurājarājyena kutaḥ prajāsukhaṃ kumitramitreṇa kuto'bhinirvṛtiḥ | kudāradāraiśca kuto gṛhe ratiḥ kuśiṣyamadhyāpayataḥ kuto yaśaḥ ||14|| siṃhādekaṃ vakādekaṃ śikṣeccatvāri kukkuṭāt | vāyasātpañca śikṣeccaṣṭ śunastrīṇigardabhāt ||15|| prabhūtaṃ kāryamapi vā tannaraḥ kartumicchati | sarvārambheṇa tatkāryaṃ siṃhādekaṃ pracakṣate ||16|| indriyāṇi ca saṃyamya vakavat paṇḍito naraḥ | deśakālabalaṃ jñātvā sarvakāryāṇi sādhayet ||17|| pratyutthānañca yudhdñca saṃvibhāgañca bandhuṣu | svayamākramyabhuktañcaśikṣeccatvārikukkuṭāt ||18|| gūḍhamaithunacāritvaṃ kāle kāle ca saṃgraham | apramattamaviśvāsaṃ pañca śikṣecca vāyasāt ||19|| bahvāśī svalpasantuṣṭaḥ sanidro laghucetanaḥ | svāmibhaktaśca śūraśca ṣaḍeto śvānatoguṇāḥ ||20|| suśrānto'pi vaheta bhāraṃ śītoṣṇaṃ na ca paśyati | santuṣṭaścarate nityaṃ trīṇi śikṣecca gardabhāt ||21|| etān viṃśatiguṇānācariṣyati mānavaḥ | kāryāvasthāsu sarvāsu ajeyaḥ sa bhaviṣyati ||22|| <7> saptamo'dhyāyaḥ arthanāśaṃ manastāpaṃ gṛhiṇīcaritāni ca | nīcavākyaṃ cā'pamānaṃ matimānna prakāśayet ||1|| dhanadhānmaprayogeṣu vidyāsaṃgrahaṇeṣu ca | āhāre vyavahāre ca tyaktalajjā sukhī bhavet ||2|| sntoṣāmṛtatṛptānāṃ yatsukhaṃ śāntireva ca | na ca tadhdanalubdhānāmitaścetaśca dhāvatām ||3|| santoṣastriṣu kartavyaḥ svadāre bhojane dhane | triṣu caiva na karttavyo'dhyayane japadānayoḥ ||4|| viprayorviprahneśca dampatyḥ svāmibhṛtyayoḥ | antareṇa na gantavyaṃ halasya vṛṣabhasma ca ||5|| pādābhyāṃ na spṛśedagni guruṃ brāhmaṇameva ca | naiva gāṃ ca kumārīna na vṛdhdaṃ na śiśuṃ tathā ||6|| hastī hastasahastreṇa śatahastena vājinaḥ | śrṛḍgiṇī daśahastena deśatyāgena durjanaḥ ||7|| hastī aṃkuśamātreṇa bājī hastena tāḍyate | śrṛḍgi lakuṭahaste na khaḍgahastena durjanaḥ ||8|| tuṣyanti bhojane viprā mayūrā ghanagarjite | sādhavaḥ parasampattau khalāḥ paravipattiṣu ||9|| anulomena balinaṃ pratilomena durjanm | ātmatulyabalaṃ śatruḥ vinayena balena vā ||10|| bāhuvīrya balaṃ rājño brahmavit balī | rūpayauvanamādhurya strīṇāṃ balamanuttamam ||11|| nā'tyantaṃ saralairbhāvyaṃ gatvā paśya vansthalīm | chidyante saralāstatra snānapānābhyāṃ vākyadānena paṃḍitāḥ ||3|| āyuḥ karma ca vittañca vidyā nidhanameva ca | pañcaitāni ca sṛjyante garbhasthasyaiva dehinaḥ ||4|| aho vata ! vicitrāṇi caritāni mahātmanām | lakṣmī tṛṇāya manyante tadbhāreṇa namanti ca ||5|| yasya sneho bhayaṃ tasya sneho duḥkhasya bhājanam | snehamūlāni duḥkhāni tāni tyaktvā vasetsukham ||6|| anāgatavidhātā ca pratyutpannamatistathā | d vāvetau sukhamedhete yadbhaviṣyo vinaśyati ||7|| rājñadharmaṇi dharmiṣṭhāḥ pāpe pāpāḥ same samāḥ | rājānamanuvartante yathā rājā tathā prajāḥ ||8|| jīvantaṃ mṛtavanmanye dehinaṃ dharmavarjitam | mṛto dharmeṇa saṃtukto dīrghajīvī na saṃśayaḥ ||9|| dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ yasyaiko'pi na vidyate | ajāgalastanasyeva tasya janma nirarthakam ||10|| dahyamānāḥ sutībreṇa nīcāḥ parayaśo'gninā | aśaktāstatpadaṃ gantuṃ tato nindāṃ prakurvate ||11|| bandhāya viṣayāsaṅgaṃ muktyai nirviṣayaṃ manaḥ | mana eva manuṣyāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bandhamokṣayoḥ ||12|| dehābhimānagalite jñānena paramātmanaḥ | yatra yatra mano yāti tatra tatra samādhayaḥ ||13|| īpsitaṃ manasaḥ sarvaṃ kasya sampadyate sukham | daivāyattaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ tasmāt saṃtoṣamāśrayet ||14|| yathā dhenusahastreṣu vatso gacchati mātaram | tathā yacca kṛtaṃ karma kartāramanugacchāti ||15|| anavasthitakāryasya na jane na vane sukham | jano dahati saṃsargādvanaṃ saṃgavivarjanāt ||16|| yat khanitvā khanitreṇa bhutale vāri vindati | tathā gurugatāṃ vidyā śuśruṣuradhigacchati ||17|| karmāyattaṃ phalaṃ puṃsāṃ budhdiḥ karmānusāriṇī | tathā'pi sudhiyaścāryā suvicāryaiva kurvate ||18|| ekākṣarapradātāraṃ yo guruṃ nā'bhivandate | śvānayoniśataṃ bhuktvā cāṃḍāleṣvabhijāyate ||19|| yugānte pracalenmeruḥ kalpānte sapta sāgarāḥ | sādhavaḥ pratipannārthānna calanti kadācana ||20|| pṛthivyāṃ trīṇi ratnāni annamāpaḥ subhāṣitam | mūḍhaiḥ pāṣāṇakhaṇḍṣu ratnasaṃkhyā vidhīyate ||21|| <14> caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ātmāparādhavṛkṣasya phalānyetāni dehinām | dāridryarogaduḥkhāni bandhanavyasanāni ca ||1|| punarvittampunarmitraṃ punarbhāryā punarmahī | etatsarvaṃ punarlabhyaṃ na śarīraṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||2|| bahunāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ samavāyo ripuñjayaḥ | varṣandhārādharo meghastṛṇairapi nivāryate ||3|| jalai tailaṃ khale guhyaṃ pātre dānaṃ manāgapi | prājñe śāstraṃ svayaṃ yāti vistāre vastuśaktitaḥ ||4|| dharmākhyāne śmaśāne ca rogiṇāṃ yā matirbhavet | sā sarvadaiva tiṣṭheccetko na mucyeta bandhanāt ||5|| utpannapaścāttāpasya budhdirbhavati yādṛśī | tādṛśī yadi pūrvaṃ syātkasya syānna mahodayaḥ ||6|| dāne tapasi śauryaṃ vā vijñāne vinaye naye | vismayo na hi kartavyo bahuratnā vasundharā ||7|| darastho'pi na dūraśo yo yasya manasi sthitaḥ | yo yasya hṛdaye nāsti samīpastho'pi dūrataḥ ||8|| yasmācca priyamicchetu tasya brūyātsadā priyam | vyādho mṛgavadhaṃ gantuṃ gītaṃ gāyati susvaram ||9|| atyāsannā vināśāya dūrasthā na phalapradāḥ | sevyatāṃ madhyabhāgena rājavihnigurustriyaḥ ||10|| agnirāpaḥ striyo mūrkhāḥ sarpo rājakulāni ca | nityaṃ yatnena sevyāni sadyaḥ prāṇaharāṇi ṣaṭ ||11|| sa jīvati guṇā yasya yasya dharmaḥ sa jīvati | guṇadharmavihīnasya jīvitaṃ niṣprayojanam ||12|| yadicchasi vaśīkartuṃ jagadekena karmaṇā | puraḥ pañcadaśāsyebhyo gāṃ carantīṃ nivāraya ||13|| prastavāsadṛśaṃ vākyaṃ prabhāvasadṛśaṃ priyam | ātmaśaktisamaṃ kopaṃ yo jānāti sa paṇḍitaḥ ||14|| eka eva padārthastu tridhā bhavati vīkṣitaḥ | kuṇapaṃkāminī māṃsaṃ yogibhiḥ kāmibhiḥ śvabhiḥ ||15|| susidhdamauṣadhaṃ dharmaṃ gṛhacchidraṃ ca maithunam | kubhuktaṃ kuśrutaṃ caiva matimānna prakāśayet ||16|| tāvanmaunena nīyante kokilaiścaiva vāsarāḥ | yāvatsarvajanānandadāyinī vāk pravartate ||17|| dharmaṃ dhanaṃ ca dhānyaṃ ca gurorvacanamauṣadham | sugṛhītaṃ ca karttavyamanyathā tu na jīvati ||18|| tyaja durjanasaṃsarga bhaja sādhusamāgamam | kuru puṇyamahorātraṃ smara nityamanityataḥ ||19|| <15> pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ yasya citaṃ dravībhūtaṃ kṛpayā sarvajantuṣu | tasya jñānena mokṣeṇa kiṃ jaṭābhasmalepanaiḥ ||1|| ekamevākṣaraṃ yastu guruḥ śiṣyaṃ prabodhayet | pṛthivyāṃ nāsti taddravyaṃ yad dattvā cānṛṇī bhavet ||2|| khalānāṃ kaṇṭakānāṃ ca dvividhaiva pratikriyā | upānad mukhabhaṅgo vā dūrataiva visarjanam ||3|| kucailinaṃ dantamalopadhāriṇāṃ bahvāśinaṃniṣṭhurabhāṣiṇāṃ ca | sūryodaye vā'stamite śayānaṃ vimuñcati śrīryadi cakrapāṇiḥ ||4|| tyajanti mitrāṇi dhanairvihīnaṃ dārāśca bhṛtyāśca suhṛjjanāśca | taṃ cārthavantaṃ punarāśrayante | hyartho hi loke puruṣasya bandhuḥ ||5|| anyāyopārjitaṃ dravyaṃ daśa varṣāṇi tiṣṭhati | prāpte ekādaśe varṣe samūlaṃ ca vinaśyati ||6|| ayuktaṃ svāmino yuktaṃ yuktaṃ nīcasya dūṣaṇam | amṛtaṃ rāhave mṛtyurviṣaṃ śaṃkarabhūṣaṇam ||7|| tadbhojanaṃ yad dvijabhuktaśeṣaṃ tatsauhṛdaṃ yatkriyate parasmin | sā prājñatā yā na karoti pāpaṃ dambhaṃ vinā yaḥ kriyate pāpaṃ dambhaṃ vinā yaḥ kriyate sa dharmaḥ ||8|| maṇirluṇṭhati pādāgre kācaḥ śirasi dhāryate | kraya vikrayavelāyāṃ kācaḥ kāco maṇirmaṇiḥ ||9|| anantaṃśāstraṃ bahulāśca vidyāḥ alpaṃ ca kālo bahuvighnatā ca | yatsārabhūtaṃ tadupāsanīyaṃ, haṃso yathā kṣīramivambumadhyāt ||10|| dūrāgataṃ pathi śrāntaṃ vṛthā ca gṛhamāgatam | anarcayitvā yo bhuṅkte sa vai cāṇḍāla ucyate ||11|| paṭhanti caturo vedān dharmaśāstrāṇyanekaśaḥ | ātmānaṃ naiva jānanti davī pākarasaṃ yathā ||12|| dhanyā dvijamayi naukā viparītā bhavārṇave | tarantyadhogatāḥ sarve uparisthāḥ patantyadhaḥ ||13|| ayamamṛtanidhānaṃ nāyako'pyauṣadhīnāṃ | amṛtamayaśarīraḥ kāntiyukto'pi candraḥ || bhavati vigataraśmirmaṇḍalaṃ prāpya bhānoḥ | parasadananiviṣṭaḥ ko laghutvaṃ na yāti ||14|| alirayaṃ nalinīdalamadhyagaḥ kamalinīmakarandamadālasaḥ | vidhivaśātparadeśamupāgataḥ kuṭajapuṣparasaṃ bahu manyate ||15|| pītaḥ krudhdena tātaścaraṇatalahatā vallabho yena roṣādābālyādvipravaryaiḥ svavadanavivare dhāryate vairiṇī meṃ | gehaṃ me chedayanti pratidivasamumākāntapūjānimittaṃ tasmātkhinnāsadāthaṃdvijakulanilayaṃ nātha yuktaṃ tyajāmi ||16|| baṃdhanāni khalu santi bahūni premarajjukṛtabandhanamanyat | dārubhedanipuṇo'piṣaṇḍaghnirniṣkriyobhavati paṃkajakośe ||17|| chinno'pi caṃdanatarurna jahāti gandhaṃ vṛdhdo'pi vāraṇapatirna jahāti līlām | yaṃtrārpito madhuratāṃ na jahāti cekṣuḥ kṣīṇo'pi na tyajati śīlaguṇān kulīnaḥ ||18|| urvyāṃ ko'pi mahīdharo laghutaro dorbhyāṃ dhṛto līlayā tena tvāṃdivi bhūtale ca sasataṃ govardhanī gīyase | tvāṃ trailokyadharaṃ vahāmi kucayoragreṇa tad gaṇyate kiṃvā keśava bhāṣaṇena bahunāpuṇyairyaśo labhyate ||19||
